candidates.name: integrated graph/evidence research control
candidates.reason: connects source/hypothesis/experiment/assessment/successor and prototype design decisions; effect and exact novelty remain untested
candidates.decisive_question: increment beyond equal-rights compulsory source-backed tree control
candidates.reopen_if: no distinguishable control delta, no independently scorable task, or unjustified cost

candidates.name: conditional negative-result reuse
candidates.reason: motivated by RecEvolve and useful in continuity, but not a substitute for broad architecture selection
candidates.reopen_if: development errors identify repeated failures or false suppression as dominant

candidates.name: context/skill contract compression
candidates.reason: Scroll/SkillZip expose recoverability/contract tradeoffs; adding now confounds research control and extraction
candidates.reopen_if: measured active-view/retrieval overhead dominates at equal outcome validity

candidates.name: fixed-controller higher-order improvement
candidates.reason: Meta^n/HarnessDev require a separate search, transfer and held-out budget; no need to bundle into first system contrast
candidates.reopen_if: one-level improvement plateaus and equal-information flat-search control is feasible
